title: The canonical map from extension by zero to direct image for a finite etale morphism
statement:
Let $\pi:U\to X$ be a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $M$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_U$-modules on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $P_M$ be the presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\operatorname{Hom}_X(V,U)}M(V,\varphi)$ on $X_{\Et}$ and $\pi_!M=P_M^\#$ its sheafification as a presheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules, the extension by zero of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], with sheafification map $\eta_M:P_M\to\pi_!M$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]; let $\pi_*M$ be the direct image, $(\pi_*M)(V)=M(V\times_XU)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], a sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules; and let $c^p_M:P_M\to\pi_*M$ be the morphism of presheaves of $\Lambda$-modules of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-graph-section-extension-map] (sending $s\in M(V,\varphi)$ to the unique section of $M(V\times_XU)$ that pulls back to $s$ along the graph $\Gamma_\varphi=(\mathrm{id}_V,\varphi)$ and vanishes off $\Gamma_\varphi(V)$).

The *canonical map from extension by zero to direct image* is the unique morphism of sheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules
$$
c_M:\pi_!M\longrightarrow\pi_*M\qquad\text{with}\qquad c_M\circ\eta_M=c^p_M,
$$
given by the universal property of sheafification. It is natural in $M$: for $\alpha:M\to M'$, $\pi_*\alpha\circ c_M=c_{M'}\circ\pi_!\alpha$, since both sides composed with $\eta_M$ equal $\pi_*\alpha\circ c^p_M=c^p_{M'}\circ P_\alpha$ (naturality of $c^p$ and of $\eta$) and the factorization through $\eta_M$ is unique. (Stacks constructs the same map for every separated etale $\pi$; only the finite etale case is used here.)
